description_en: 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE IN ASTIR, 2+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE 📍IN ASTIR, NEAR BAR ARTISTI A functionally organized 2+1 apartment is offered for sale, positioned in the area of ​​Astir, very close to Bar Artisti, one of the most sought-after areas and with quick access to daily services. 📐 Total area: 98.4 m² 📐 Net area: 86.3 m² 🏢 Floor: 5 🛗 Building with elevator, built in 2013 🛋 Furnished Interior organization: Open-concept living and cooking environment, naturally lit 2 comfortable and functional bedrooms 1 bathroom Balcony, suitable for relaxation Distribution corridor that guarantees privacy and comfort Quality & advantages: The apartment is sold furnished, ready for living or investment Quality construction and regular maintenance of the building Area with quick access to main roads, schools, markets, pharmacies and public transport Ideal for both family living and investment 📄 Documentation: The property has a mortgage and is also sold with a bank loan. 💶 Price: 155,000 euros;
